summary: First test run for RigRent MVP (FastAPI + Expo/React Native). Backend: 22/22 pytest tests PASSED including AI license & insurance verification (GPT-5.4 vision extracted expiry dates correctly), commission split math, RBAC on listings/bookings/settings/bids, license-gated booking, roadside bidding flow, admin verifications. Frontend: mobile viewport UI validated for all 4 roles - renter sees marketplace with 4 seeded rigs & 7 category chips and commission split module on listing detail, booking properly redirects to verification screen when unverified. Owner sees Dashboard/My Rigs (with 4 rigs) tabs. Vendor sees Jobs tab. Admin sees rate stepper (15%, owner keeps 85%) and Review Verifications button. Role-based tab visibility working correctly. Logout returns to /auth. No red screens, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_settings() calls insert_one({'id':'global',...}) without upsert; safe due to guard but race-prone under high concurrency - consider upsert.
storage init failure only logs; verify/upload endpoints still attempt upload and would 502 - already handled but path=None branch in verify_document is fine.

GET /api/files/{path} accepts a token query param but doesn't validate it or restrict ownership; any authenticated-or-not caller who knows the path can fetch the file. Consider auth check or signed URLs for private documents (license photos).
Booking POST does not check listing.active/deleted_at explicitly beyond the query (fine), but no date-range conflict check across bookings - future feature.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed users and one TEST_ listing via APIs (owner-created listing deleted after test). Two TEST_ renter accounts were left in DB after AI verification tests (needed persistent state). No cleanup needed for the seeded demo listings which are idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in frontend/.env; tests read env var or fall back to preview URL. pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope; run pytest with `-n 0` for serial or omit for default parallel. AI verification (GPT-5.4 vision) works for both license and insurance; generated PIL text images with future expiry dates in /tmp/lic.jpg and /tmp/ins.jpg. File GET endpoint may need auth hardening if private docs concern.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no issues found in this iteration.
